name: Oliver
summary: Oliver is a fast-paced, pixel-art adventure featuring three distinct game modes tailored for quick, exhilarating play sessions. Players can dive into a side-scrolling endless runner across sweeping landscapes, soar through volcanic caves in a precision-based flight challenge, or survive relentless waves of enemies in a top-down dungeon shooter. Designed with the Godot Engine from the ground up, Oliver blends responsive gameplay with handcrafted visuals and atmospheric sound. Its variety of mechanics—from obstacle dodging to combat endurance—offers a dynamic experience built around replayability and skill mastery, all wrapped in a retro-styled aesthetic that highlights the game’s creative depth.
